chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud Security & Access Policy 2026
chunks.content: All Enterprise accounts must enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP, WebAuthn FIDO2 keys, or verified SAML SSO. SMS-based 2FA is deprecated and disallowed for administrative accounts. In case of 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the target user identity is locked for 15 minutes unless unlocked via administrator authorization.

chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud Security & Access Policy 2026
chunks.section: Section 4.3: IP Address Filtering & CIDR Allowlists
chunks.content: Organizations may restrict console and API access to designated IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges. In the event an authorized engineer is locked out due to network IP changes, break-glass recovery tokens must be used alongside secondary approval from an Organization Owner.

chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud Security & Access Policy 2026
chunks.content: The platform defines three core roles: ADMIN (full permissions, user management, billing, knowledge library mutation), SUPPORT_AGENT (ticket queue management, conversation handling, knowledge retrieval), and CUSTOMER (ticket submission, chat assistance, personal history access).

chunks.title: Billing, Invoicing & Refund Protocols v4.2
chunks.content: Customers are eligible for a 100% full refund within 30 days of initial subscription purchase without question. Beyond 30 days, prorated refunds are only granted in the event of documented service downtime exceeding SLA thresholds (99.9% uptime requirement). To initiate a refund, customers must submit a ticket under the "Refunds" category.

chunks.title: Billing, Invoicing & Refund Protocols v4.2
chunks.content: When an automated credit card charge fails, the billing engine attempts retry attempts on Day 1, Day 3, and Day 7. The customer enters a 14-day grace period during which full platform services remain accessible. If payment is not settled by Day 14, account capabilities transition to Read-Only mode.

chunks.title: Billing, Invoicing & Refund Protocols v4.2
chunks.section: Section 4.1: Annual Invoicing and Net-30 Terms
chunks.content: Enterprise subscriptions totaling over $10,000 annually may opt for manual purchase order invoicing under Net-30 payment terms. Wire transfer and ACH details are provided on every official invoice PDF.

chunks.title: API Rate Limiting, Quotas & Webhook Specifications
chunks.content: The API enforces a token-bucket rate limiter. Enterprise tier keys receive 1,000 requests per minute with bursts up to 1,500. Growth tier keys are limited to 300 requests per minute. Standard responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset timestamps.

chunks.title: API Rate Limiting, Quotas & Webhook Specifications
chunks.content: All outgoing webhooks are signed using HMAC-SHA256 with the shared webhook secret passed in the X-SupportIQ-Signature header. Receivers must verify this signature and record the X-Delivery-ID to ensure idempotent processing in case of automatic retries (exponential backoff up to 5 times over 24 hours).

chunks.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) & IdP Integration Runbook
chunks.content: To configure SAML 2.0 SSO in your Identity Provider (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin, Google Workspace), input the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL: https://app.supportiq.io/api/auth/saml/callback and Entity ID: urn:supportiq:saml:sp. Provide the X.509 Certificate and IdP Single Sign-On URL in Settings > Security.

chunks.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) & IdP Integration Runbook
chunks.content: SupportIQ supports SCIM 2.0 protocol for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning. When an employee is deactivated in Okta or Azure AD, their SupportIQ account is automatically suspended within 60 seconds, reallocating active support tickets to the team pool.

conversations.title: What is the refund policy within 30 days?

messages.content: What is the refund policy within 30 days?

Hello,

Thank you for reaching out! Here are the details regarding our refund policy within the first 30 days:

* **100% Full Refund:** You are eligible for a full (100%) refund within 30 days of your initial subscription purchase, no questions asked.
* **How to Initiate:** To request your refund, please submit a support ticket categorized under **"Refunds"**, and our team will be happy to assist you with processing it.

If you have any further questions or need help opening your ticket, please let us know!

citations.snippet: Customers are eligible for a 100% full refund within 30 days of initial subscription purchase without question. Beyond 30 days, prorated refunds are only granted in the event of documented service downtime exceeding SLA thresholds (99.9% uptime requirement). To initiate a refund, customers must submit a ticket under the "Refunds" category.

All Enterprise accounts must enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP, WebAuthn FIDO2 keys, or verified SAML SSO. SMS-based 2FA is deprecated and disallowed for administrative accounts. In case of 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the target user identity is locked for 15 minutes unless unlocked via administrator authorization.

When an automated credit card charge fails, the billing engine attempts retry attempts on Day 1, Day 3, and Day 7. The customer enters a 14-day grace period during which full platform services remain accessible. If payment is not settled by Day 14, account capabilities transition to Read-Only mode.

messages.content: What are the required Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL and Entity ID to set up Okta SAML?

According to our official Single Sign-On (SSO) & IdP Integration Runbook:

• **ACS URL**: `https://app.supportiq.io/api/auth/saml/callback`
• **Entity ID / Audience URI**: `urn:supportiq:saml:sp`

Ensure you provide your X.509 Certificate and IdP Single Sign-On URL in **Settings > Security**. Once saved, all users logging in from your corporate domain will be redirected through your IdP.

messages.content: What is our eligibility for a refund if we downgrade our plan after 20 days?

You are completely covered! Under our verified Billing, Invoicing & Refund Protocols (v4.2), you have a **30-Day Money-Back Guarantee**:

1. Customers are eligible for a 100% full refund within 30 days of initial purchase.
2. In the case of mid-cycle downgrades within 30 days, prorated credits or refunds can be processed immediately.
3. Beyond 30 days, refunds require documented service downtime exceeding SLA thresholds (99.9% uptime requirement).
